name: Independence (United States)
description: White field within a purple-blue border, charged with a red map of Kentucky, a purple Aristocrat pear tree, a star and the words CITY OF INDEPENDENCE Established 1842.
history: Independence is a city in Kenton County, Kentucky. The flag was adopted on 6 February 2006 (unveiled by Mayor Chris Moriconi at the city council meeting of 6 February 2006 after a citizens' vote among four designs, according to Flags of the World quoting the city website; the pear tree honours William T. Straw, who propagated the Aristocrat pear).

features.role: words CITY OF INDEPENDENCE and Established 1842
